g.text: DeepSeek-V3 geometry: 61 layers, 128 query heads, head_dim 128, bf16. GQA and MQA shrink the cache by giving several query
heads one KV head, trading a little quality for it; MLA instead caches a 512-dim latent plus a 64-dim shared RoPE key and
reconstructs K and V on the fly, landing 57x below MHA -- MQA territory -- with no head tying and reported quality at or above
MHA's. The dashed line is one 8xH100 node's total memory, before weights: at 128k context and batch 32, MHA wants over 25
nodes' worth of cache and MLA fits in half of one.
